ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  B&B Triplewall Containers Limited has submitted its regulatory compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (Purva Sharegistry) confirmed that all dematerialization requests, if any, were processed correctly and within prescribed timelines, with names substituted in the register of members. A key takeaway is that the accompanying table explicitly indicates "NIL" activity for dematerialization during this quarter, signifying no physical shares were submitted for conversion to electronic form.
